messages.subject: Re: Plot overlap output
parts:
Hi  Théo,

Most functionality in ctmmweb is in exported functions:  https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmmwebdoc/reference/index.html
I don't see the overlap plotting functionality in there, though, but I could probably backport that in a couple of weeks.

The default pHREML is used in ctmmweb and you can turn on the weight optimization in ctmmweb.

Best,
Chris
